remaining_boundaries: These are source/mocked-operation/tiny-file controls, not an observed CI run or OS containment qualification. The future CI artifact and job status still require actual byte auditing.
Resource admission covers observed Linux x86_64 visible cgroup-v2 ancestors and host memory/affinity. It does not prove hidden hierarchy limits, ongoing isolation, or whole-run resource availability.

Owned llama servers inherit the wrapper process group. Frozen HIA Clang capture can create an independent session; outer failure cannot prove all descendants closed. Missing engine-close receipts remain null, incomplete cohorts fail qualification, and fresh VM disposal is the remaining containment boundary.

The original 15/24 aborted cohort remains unchanged. The new planned 24-cell run is a separately registered exploratory replication of already-seen tasks; it does not prove a memory-pressure cause or general Agent superiority.

Credential checks used fake tokens and mock HTTP. No real credential was accessed. Current source does not record Authorization, a general environment dump, or download redirect signed URLs; actual future uploaded bytes remain to be reviewed.

Bounded artifact staging may retain a partial inventory on storage/provider failure; unknown usage and cleanup are not filled with zero or success. Receipt self-hashes and upload duration are explicitly outside the local completed interval.

Per-stage and model costs are nested observations. Parent/child intervals must not be summed twice. Provisioning before bootstrap, provider action internals, upload until observed, human engineering and complete economic cost remain unknown. MaxRSS is a completed-process high-water mark, not simultaneous aggregate RSS.
